title: A GTA 6 leak got 8M views. It was 100% AI.
description: Fake leaks, fake trailers and malware: the GTA 6 hoaxes debunked, with sources.

lines.text: A GTA 6 leak got over 8 million views. It was fake. 100% AI.
lines.headline: 8M VIEWS. ALL AI.

lines.text: The creator later admitted the whole thing was a hoax.
The Vice City bridge leak? Fake. Its creator showed how he made it.
Download GTA 6 for PC? That's a scam. No PC version has been announced, and those files carry malware.
lines.headline: MALWARE

lines.text: A leaker dropping the full game? False. He said himself there's no build.
Delayed again to 2027? Not true. Take-Two locked November 19th.
And Trailer 3? Those videos are fake. Rockstar never released a video with that name.
Follow for confirmed GTA 6 news. No fake leaks.
lines.headline: FOLLOW FOR REAL NEWS
